items.item_text: As the Purchasing Manager for the Department of Neurology, you will lead a team of Procurement and Accounts Payable Specialists who support faculty, staff, research labs, and administrative units. Serving as the department’s primary procurement resource, you will oversee purchasing operations, travel and reimbursement processing, staff development, and compliance with University policies.

You will partner closely with campus stakeholders and vendors to ensure timely purchasing and payment processing, resolve procurement issues, and deliver outstanding customer service. Through effective leadership and collaboration, you will play a key role in supporting the Department’s clinical, research, and educational missions.
Working level of proficiency in the use of standard spreadsheet and word processing software.
Understands procurement policies and systems such as Procurement, Travel systems, etc.
Analytical skills necessary to evaluate the cost effectiveness of purchasing options.
Some knowledge of the organization's departments and operations required in order to meet their procurement needs.
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Ability to read and interpret terms and conditions of contracts.
Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, with high degree of accuracy.
